end.summary:
- Practised speed = distance ÷ time using a bus example.
- Identified missing distance and time in under-specified questions.
- Calculated 20 × 3 = 60 metres when speed and time were provided.
- Discussed braking with a = (v − u) ÷ t and a negative acceleration value.
- Identified velocity to the right and acceleration to the left during rightward braking; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Diya practised checking whether distance, time, and speed data are available before calculating, then used speed × time to find 60 metres. A mix-up about whether braking involves acceleration was addressed by the end of the lesson, but the full explanation was not yet teach-back passed.
